snippet.title: ANANTA Launch Date Trailer | Global Release January 15th, 2027
snippet.description:
The story of ANANTA unfolds between Nova City and Chongxiao's Lingyun City. Assemble your squad, adventure through different cities, and uncover hidden truths. But that's not all! You can also experience various walks of life and the distinct lifestyle of each city.
